title: Attack evidence
intro: Sixteen well-known ways AI agents have been tricked into moving money (Freysa, Grok and Bankrbot, AIXBT, ElizaOS memory, the $1 Chevrolet Tahoe, push-payment fraud and more), recreated against Kassa and against a naive agent that executes the same intent with no guards.
guarded: with Kassa's rules, payment checks and passkey
naive: by the same agent without them
how: Generated by the automated test suite (bun run evidence:attacks) on the real Kassa modules with simulated rails; the planner and the document reader are scripted, so every run is the same. Source: docs/evidence/attacks.json.
